Nora asked that we discuss the implementation details here in the case review rather than circulate the medical basis. This is directly relevant to how we structure today's discussion and any next steps, including any formal performance warning or support plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.documented_root_cause: The two handoff delays were caused by missing client inputs at the time Nora's work was due, combined with the absence of a shared handoff checklist and an approved accommodation limiting Nora to three concurrent client escalations. Nora completed each handoff within one business day of receiving the missing inputs.

commitments.detail: Formalize the peer feedback partner arrangement for four weeks, as Nora has already informally agreed to.
Create a shared handoff checklist that documents handoff expectations, including required client inputs and timelines.
Ensure all future performance-review discussions with Nora include written agendas and prompts at least two business days in advance, per her approved accommodation.
